name: Ombilin Coal Mining Heritage of Sawahlunto
description: In the highlands of West Sumatra, about 70 km northeast of Padang, Sawahlunto grew from a remote valley into a Dutch colonial coal town. Mining began here in 1876, making it Southeast Asia's oldest coal mining site. The listing covers the mines and company town, a railway that carried coal down to the coast, and coal storage at the port of Emmahaven. Minangkabau, Javanese, Chinese and convict workers all helped build it.
